text:
Type: square high-pile geometric rug
Use: anchoring a seating or reading area; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, mid-century modern, Scandinavian
Materials: soft thick cut pile, fine carved line pattern
Colors: dark grey, mustard yellow, beige, off-white lines
Shape: square with a central yellow square framed by four striped trapezoids, optical perspective effect, plush and thick, large and bold
Feel: graphic, warm, striking
Goes with: grey sofas, mustard or ochre accents, light wood, white walls; mid-century or modern living rooms

product.name: BIRKET
product.description: The dense, thick pile dampens sound and provides a soft surface to walk on.
